messages:
ashley (marketing): quick thread  we need a distinct benchmark narrative for launch: show latency vs unit-cost but split messaging for devs vs procurement. want chart ideas + CTA routing.
diego (growth): agree. devs want p50/p95 + perf contours; procurement wants clear $/1k and predictable runway charts. we should make two hero variants.
miko (design): chart ideas that differ from prior: 1) median-latency scatter (each point = seq_len bucket, size = batch), 2) stacked waterfall for cost reduction stages, 3) a small ridgeline/density plot showing latency distribution by model size. mobile collapse: show only cost waterfall.
rachel (product): data source: v2-opt end-to-end + dedicated quant runs. i'll tag rows with model_size and cache_state. Owen, can you give a tiny sample for layout?
owen (analytics): sample scatter CSV for layout:
```
seq_bucket,batch,median_ms,cost_per_1k
64,8,42,0.020
128,32,78,0.018
512,8,190,0.020
1024,32,450,0.007
```
use point size ~batch and color by seq_bucket.
miko (design): nice. for the hero copy we can do two lanes: "Developer" headline + tech bullets; "Procurement" headline + cost/runway bullets. small shared subhead: "Predictable inference: latency you can budget for, costs you can forecast."
dashley (marketing): (typo correction) ashley: will own experiment wiring. CTA variants: Dev lane -> "Try the API"; Biz lane -> "Estimate your savings". route Biz leads to savings calculator form.
diego (growth): inbound routing rules proposal: if form estimate >$1500/mo OR predicted tokens >80k then tag AE; if dev signup with >10k tokens in first week tag SDR. also flag partner referrals.
rachel (product): webinar segmentation: 1) ML engineers (deep dive + benchmarks), 2) Platform/infra (autoscaling, KV cache), 3) Procurement/finance (unit economics + TCO). different CTAs on landing to funnel.
owen (analytics): AB plan: two hero variants (Dev-first vs Biz-first). measure CTR, signup quality (tokens in week1), demo requests, MQL conversion. dashboard owner = owen + diego.
miko (design): deliver desktop hero with scatter + waterfall + tiny ridgeline by Thu. need final headers by Wed noon. i'll include small footnote for quantization and batch assumptions.
dashley (marketing): timeline: copy Wed, design Thu, review Mon, experiment go-live next Wed. owners: ashley marketing, miko design, rachel product, owen analytics, diego growth. quick sign-off Mon 10m.
diego (growth): small win: add a micro-case stat under Biz lane if legal ok, e.g., "Customer X cut unit cost 3x with dedicated configs" but keep qualifier.
rachel (product): i'll ask solutions for a one-liner. thanks team. :sparkles:
